text:
This plan misses 23 (episode, follower) pairs, which is the fewest I found. I compared about a dozen arrangements by hand but did not search every possible schedule, so I can't prove 23 is the minimum. It costs 9 periods, $107.88 in total.

**Why some misses are unavoidable**
- The limit of two non-required services matters a lot. Up to 11/11, the already-paid services leave no free slot, so the first new period can start on 11/12.
- After that, two slots are free. From early December, the household needs:
  - Orbit almost continuously until 3/7, because Leah's 2-day windows come twice a week.
  - Marquee almost continuously from 12/22 to 2/4.
  - Kestrel at least every two weeks until 3/7.
  - Northline for one day between 12/26 and 1/2. That day is worth 31 pairs.
  - Pebble for one day between 2/11 and 2/18. That day is worth 18 pairs.
- Each of these takes a whole month of a slot. That is roughly 10 months of demand for about 7 months of slot space, so something has to give.

**The plan, slot by slot**

| Dates | Slot A | Slot B |
|---|---|---|
| 11/12–11/29 | Pebble (Velvet Atlas) | Kestrel (already paid) |
| 11/30–12/11 | Pebble | Northline (Quiet Ferry, Velvet Garden) |
| 12/12–12/29 | Kestrel | Northline |
| 12/30–1/11 | Kestrel | Orbit |
| 1/12–1/29 | Marquee | Orbit |
| 1/30–1/31 | Marquee | (nothing) |
| 2/1–2/11 | Marquee | Orbit |
| 2/12–2/28 | Pebble (Distant Ferry) | Orbit |
| 3/1–3/11 | Pebble | Orbit |
| 3/12–3/31 | Lumen (Northern Orchard) | Orbit |

No day has more than two non-required services. No period overlaps another period or already-paid access for the same service.

**The 23 missed pairs**
- **Orbit (9):** Orbit can't start until Northline ends on 12/30, so the first Silver Archive episodes come too late.
  - 12/6: all 3 followers.
  - 12/13: all 3 followers.
  - 12/20: Nora and Leah.
  - 12/27: Leah.
- **Kestrel (8):**
  - Velvet Orchard 1/13: Kofi and Priya.
  - Copper Circuit 1/17 through 2/21: Priya, 6 episodes.
- **Marquee (6):**
  - 12/22: all 3 followers.
  - 12/29: Nora and Leah.
  - 1/5: Leah.

Everything else is watched in time.

**Trade-offs checked**
- **Starting Orbit on 12/12:** this would save 8 Orbit pairs. However, it pushes Kestrel or Marquee out, and the total rises to 32 or more.
- **Shifting Kestrel and Marquee to 12/14 and 1/14:** this saves 2 Kestrel pairs but loses 2 Marquee pairs, so there is no net gain.
